Subject: Embeddings call recap + proposed next steps

Hi Elena \u00151 thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment.

Call recap
- Use case: semantic product search + cross-sell recommendations for SearchLytics storefront. Primary dataset: product catalog + user behavioral logs (clicks, add-to-cart).
- Main goals: improve top-10 retrieval relevance (reduce false positives), surface semantically-similar products for recommendations, and ensure embedding dimensionality and storage costs are reasonable.
- Constraints: ~10M product vectors in total long-term; latency requirement: 50ms p95 for vector lookup in dedicated environment; security: SOC2-required for PII handling.

Initial observations / questions we raised
- Need a representative sample of catalog + queries (you shared a 5k-row sample during call) \u00151 thanks.
- Concern about drift: product metadata changes frequently (daily) \u00151 we discussed refresh cadence and delta updates.
- Dimensionality trade-offs: 1536 vs 1024 vs 768 \u00151 balance between accuracy and storage/nearest-neighbor index speed.

Redwood recommended next steps (proposal)
1) Quick eval run on your sample (we'll compute recall@10, MRR, avg_cosine_gap, and cluster purity). We ran a baseline on the sample and attached preliminary results (embeddings_eval_results_v1.csv).
2) Compare two embedding families: redwood-embed-2-large (1536d) and redwood-embed-1-small (768d) on your prompt/query set. We recommend starting with redwood-embed-2-large for accuracy-sensitive routes and redwood-embed-1-small for cheaper read-only recommendations.
3) Provide prompt sets and canonical queries (we'll need 200-300 representative queries). You mentioned you can surface top 200 from GA/DB \u00151 can you share by EOD Thu?
4) POC timeline: 2 weeks for evaluation runs + index tuning; 4 more weeks for a production pilot on a dedicated pool.

Attachments: searchlytics_corpus_sample.csv (your sample), embeddings_eval_results_v1.csv (our initial baseline). Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-eval-results

Next steps / asks for you
- Please confirm you can share the 200 query set and a 1k expanded sample (anonymized) by Thu 02/27.
- Any security/compliance contacts we should loop in for SOC2 evidence?

I'll loop in Rishi (applied ML) and Marissa (CS) to add technical notes and logistics.

Thanks,

Hi Elena \u00151 quick technical notes following Marcus's summary.

1) Metrics we will report (per-run): recall@10, recall@1, MRR, mean_cosine_similarity_positive_vs_negative (avg gap), and cluster purity by product category. For drift, we'll compute KL divergence on embedding norms and cosine similarity drift against a historic snapshot (if available).

2) Dimensionality guidance:
- 1536d (redwood-embed-2-large): best accuracy, higher index size (~2x vs 768d), slower ANN throughput but fewer false positives. Good for search endpoints where relevance directly impacts conversion.
- 768d (redwood-embed-1-small): near-parity on many product catalogs, ~40-60% lower storage, faster ANN queries. Good for bulk recommendation/feature-store use.

3) Indexing & ANN: We'll test HNSW params (ef_construction, M) for your 10k sample and extrapolate. For production with 10M vectors, we recommend a hybrid approach: compressed vectors (quantization) + retriever fusion (coarse + rerank) to hit p95 latency goals.

4) Prompt sets: When you share queries, please include label (search vs browse vs recommendation) and ideal result examples where possible. That helps build per-route thresholds.

I'll prepare a short evaluation script and upload results to the Drive folder.

-Rishi
